title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Championship Leaders
items.text: Michael Brennan and Beau Hossler move near the lead at -16 late in the Wyndham Championship final round, with Tom Kim close behind at -15 at Sedgefield.

items.headline: DeChambeau on Fan Support
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau claimed every golf fan wants to see him play big PGA Tour events despite his LIV Golf status, highlighting ongoing uncertainties about his Tour eligibility.
